mechanisms.label: Strategic aluminium

The Pentagon’s war‑game in summer 2026 highlighted this risk, and the Department of Defense has identified a need for additional HPA supplies within the next two years.  No official U.S. government source in the candidate set confirms a current strategic aluminium mechanism, but the cited articles (Bloomberg, Fortune, Financial Post, BilyonaryO, Economic Times) all report the same concern about limited domestic HPA capacity and the urgency for additional supply to meet military demand.
